subject: Hosted API pricing — request for cost parity / committed rate match
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@edgeworks.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API baseline + competitor parity request

Hi Ben,

Were getting close to finalizing a vendor for hosted inference for our conversational search product. Before we proceed we need a clear baseline from Redwood and to understand whether you can offer cost parity with the commitments our procurement team is seeing from other vendors.

Specifically:
- Can you provide your hosted API baseline rates for text generation and embeddings (1k-token equivalencies)?
- If we commit to an annual spend, what discount tiers do you offer and what minimums are required?
- Can Redwood match the blended committed rates EdgeWorks has from Together / Anthropic for generation-heavy workloads? (Our reference numbers: Together: $0.012/1k gen tokens committed; Anthropic enterprise blended $0.018/1k depending on term).

Attached is our RFP summary (EdgeWorks_RFP.pdf) with expected QPS and 99th percentile latency SLOs. Wed like a written baseline and, if possible, a written statement on parity/match options by EOD Monday so we can include it in our vendor scorecard.

Thanks —
Lena Ortiz
Head of Platform
EdgeWorks

Attachment: EdgeWorks_RFP.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@edgeworks.ai>, procurement@edgeworks.ai
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline + competitor parity request

Lena — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. I appreciate the reference numbers.

Quick notes while I pull the exact numbers:
- Ive attached our current hosted API ratecard (Redwood_ratecard_v2.pdf) with published public tiers.
- We do offer committed discounts; the effective blended rate depends heavily on token mix (short prompts vs long completions) and whether embeddings are significant in your mix.

To give you a tight response I need two quick datapoints from you:
1) Expected monthly token volume (gen tokens + context tokens) and embedding calls — ballpark for months 1–3 and steady-state.
2) Desired term (12/18/24 months) and any legal/compliance must-haves (e.g., data residency, audit logs).

If it's easier we can hop on a 30-min call Monday AM — Ill bring Stephanie from Sales Ops who helps model committed blends.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_ratecard_v2.pdf (public hosted API ratecard, 3 pages)
From: Procurement <procurement@edgeworks.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline + competitor parity request

Ben —
Thanks. Quick answers below (we appreciate the fast turnaround).

- Ballpark volume: Month 1: 20M gen tokens, 200k embedding calls; Steady-state: 120M gen tokens/month, 1.2M embedding calls/month.
- Desired term: 18 months preferred.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; VPC/network isolation is a + but not mandatory initially; logging/auditability required.

EdgeWorks has a tentative committed offer elsewhere (Together) at a blended $0.012/1k gen tokens for a 18-month, $1.8M annual commitment (they carve embeddings separately at $0.003/1k). Anthropics enterprise indications are closer to $0.017–0.019/1k.

Can Redwood provide a written parity statement against Togethers committed blended rate of $0.012/1k for gen tokens under an 18-month commitment? If not exact match, please propose the best achievable blended point and any tradeoffs (e.g., min term, committed spend, SLAs).

Lena and I are available Monday for a short call.

Procurement
EdgeWorks

Attachment: EdgeWorks_RFP.pdf (referenced)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API baseline + competitor parity request — need pricing guidance

Team — forwarding EdgeWorkss volume + target competitor rates. Theyre asking if we can match Together's committed blended gen rate of $0.012/1k for an 18-month term at roughly $1.8M/year. Embeddings are ~1.2M/month steady state.

Questions:
- Can Pricing/Ops support a parity offer at or near $0.012/1k gen with these volumes? If not, what's our best blended we can propose with standard exclusions?
- Any constraints around latency SLO or dedicated isolation that materially change unit economics?

Id like to propose a concrete offer to EdgeWorks by EOD. Looping Steph for modeling and Aditya for pricing approval.

—Ben

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API baseline + competitor parity request — need pricing guidance

Ben/Steph —

We can get within striking distance if EdgeWorks accepts a couple of standard guardrails. Topline recommendation:

Offer structure (proposed):
- Term: 18 months
- Committed annual spend: $1.8M (invoice schedule can be quarterly or monthly with committed minimums)
- Blended generation rate: $0.013/1k gen tokens (effective assuming the token mix you provided — short prompts + long completions model)
- Embeddings: $0.0025/embedding (per 1k embedding-equivalent)
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime on hosted API; 99th P99 latency target per the RFP; Dedicated VPC available at additional setup fee and small monthly premium if they require private subnets.

Constraints / rationale:
- $0.012/1k exact parity with Together would put us at or below incremental hardware cost in some months given their aggressive bundling; a $0.013 blended is sustainable under current capacity and still materially better than Anthropic indications.
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit ($50k) to improve effective TCO in year 1 if they sign within 30 days.
- Any VPC/dedicated isolation increases fixed cost; if they opt-in, we should add a setup fee (one-time) of $25k and a small 5% premium on unit rates or re-evaluate committed minimums.

Please approve so Ben can present. Ive also drafted a short pricing memo (pricing_approval_memo.docx) for Rishis sign-off if we want to proceed.

—Aditya
Director, Pricing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_approval_memo.docx (internal approval memo)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@edgeworks.ai>, procurement@edgeworks.ai
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API baseline + competitor parity request — Redwood proposal

Lena / team —

Thanks for the quick info and for the patience while we scoped this. Based on your volumes and an 18-month commitment, Redwood can propose the following commercial:

Summary offer (commercial):
- Term: 18 months; committed annual spend: $1.8M
- Generation (blended): $0.013 / 1k gen tokens (assumes token mix noted in your RFP)
- Embeddings: $0.0025 / 1k-equivalent
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 applied in the first invoice if signed within 30 days
- Optional VPC / Dedicated: setup fee $25,000 + small monthly premium or we can re-model if you require full private deployment.
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime (hosted), P99 latency commitments as discussed in your RFP; audit logs and SOC 2 evidence available.

Next steps:
1) If this is acceptable in principle Ill ask Legal to draft a one-page commercial term sheet + SOW.
2) Well include a DocuSign link for signature and a HubSpot record for the deal.
3) If you want us to explore getting to $0.012/1k we can re-run a capacity pledge (longer term or higher minimum) — would need final confirmation on commitment cadence.

Would you like me to send the term sheet for review or schedule a 30-min call to iron out SOW and delivery dates?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
